title: Điền câu vào đoạn văn (2)
intro: Đề tốt nghiệp câu 18–22: chọn câu/cụm từ điền vào đoạn văn. Mẹo: xem câu trước và sau chỗ trống; kiểm tra ngữ pháp (mệnh đề quan hệ, rút gọn mệnh đề, chủ ngữ) và ý có liên kết không.
instruction: Chọn phương án phù hợp nhất cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.title: Coral reefs
items.passage: Coral reefs are often called the "rainforests of the sea" (1) ___. Although they cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor, they support about a quarter of all marine species. Sadly, reefs around the world are in danger. (2) ___, the water becomes too warm and corals lose their colour, a process known as "bleaching". Pollution and overfishing make the situation even worse, (3) ___. To protect reefs, many countries have created marine parks (4) ___. Scientists are also growing corals in nurseries and planting them on damaged reefs, (5) ___.

options: because they are home to so many different species
that they are home to so many species
being home so many different species
because of they are home to many species
items.explain: Nêu lý do: because + mệnh đề.

options: When sea temperatures rise
Sea temperatures rising
Sea temperatures rise
Because of sea temperatures rise
items.explain: Mệnh đề trạng ngữ thời gian When + S + V, rồi mệnh đề chính.

options: putting even more pressure on these fragile ecosystems
which put even more pressure on it
put even more pressure on these fragile ecosystems
and it putting more pressure on ecosystems
items.explain: Rút gọn mệnh đề chỉ kết quả: …, putting more pressure on…

options: where fishing and tourism are strictly controlled
which fishing and tourism are strictly controlled
that fishing and tourism strictly control
fishing and tourism are controlled there
items.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ nơi chốn: marine parks where…

options: hoping to help the reefs recover
hoped to help the reefs recover
they hope to help the reefs recover
which hoping the reefs recover
items.explain: Rút gọn chủ động (cùng chủ ngữ Scientists): …, hoping to…

items.title: The generation gap
items.passage: The generation gap refers to differences in values and attitudes between older and younger people. In many Vietnamese families, three generations live under one roof, (6) ___. For example, grandparents may think that young people spend too much time on their phones, (7) ___. Parents, meanwhile, often have high expectations about their children's careers, (8) ___. To reduce conflict, family members need to listen to each other with respect. (9) ___, they can find activities that everyone enjoys, such as cooking or travelling together. In the end, (10) ___.

options: so differences between generations are easy to notice
which differences between generations noticing
and noticing differences between generations easy
differences between generations are easy to notice them
items.explain: Nối mệnh đề kết quả bằng so + mệnh đề đầy đủ.

options: while teenagers see technology as an important part of life
teenagers seeing technology as an important part of life
which teenagers see technology important
while technology seeing as important by teenagers
items.explain: while + mệnh đề: đối lập hai cách nhìn.

options: which can put pressure on young people
that can put pressure on young people
can put pressure on young people
putting young people on pressure
items.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (sau dấu phẩy) dùng which, không dùng that.

options: In addition
On the contrary
As a result of
Despite
items.explain: Thêm một giải pháp nữa: In addition.

options: understanding is the key to a happy family
the key to a happy family understanding
which understanding is the key
to understand being the key to a happy family
items.explain: Sau "In the end," cần mệnh đề đầy đủ: understanding is the key…
